evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Per-attempt timestamps, strategy identifiers, chain, notional and capital exposure.
Realised entry and exit amounts with complete fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, builder payments, rent/account effects and platform fees.
Structured attribution of STRATEGY/MARKET losses versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
Costs of reverted, dropped, timed-out and otherwise failed attempts.
Quote-to-simulation-to-fill deterioration and quote age distributions by chain and strategy.
Verified Solana exit sellability and full-size Jupiter round-trip economics for every observed position.
EVM receipt and balance reconciliation, including fee-settlement transaction costs and pending fees.
Money-weighted net P&L, profit factor, drawdown and capital-time utilisation by strategy, chain and notional bucket.
Independent forward out-of-sample results across high- and low-cost market regimes.

Before any promotion: statistically adequate positive money-weighted net P&L after every cost, bounded execution-failure rate, complete loss attribution, verified exits, no unresolved reconciliation gaps and successful held-out SHADOW validation.

proposals.downside_risk: Classification rules can mislabel ambiguous failures and reduce apparent sample size.

evidence.detail: Metrics aggregate net profit and execution_failures, but evaluate_strategy does not use execution-failure rate in promotion decisions.
SHADOW outcomes are quote-simulated net values and explicitly are not realised P&L.
EVM execution exceptions are recorded as REJECTED without a structured strategy/market versus execution/infrastructure cause.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces money-weighted net P&L by strategy and chain alongside failure-cost and failure-rate attribution, preventing promotion of nominally positive strategies whose executable edge is consumed by infrastructure failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent time windows, 100 eligible opportunities and 50 executable simulations per chain and strategy, including at least 20 observed failure cases across the reviewed population.
proposals.rationale: A losing executable trade is strategy/market evidence; a revert, timeout, RPC error, stale quote or unavailable exit is execution/infrastructure evidence. Mixing them prevents correct strategy selection and understates the economic cost of failed attempts.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW, classify every eligible attempt as STRATEGY_MARKET_RESULT, EXECUTION_INFRA_FAILURE or NO_TRADE_NO_EDGE; attach notional, all estimated/realised costs and opportunity timestamp. Stop and rework if more than 5% remain unclassified or reconciled net differs from component totals by more than 1 basis point.

proposals.downside_risk: A conservative reserve may reject genuinely profitable brief opportunities.

evidence.detail: Scanner slippage reserve is gross_profit multiplied by slippage bps, rather than exposure/notional multiplied by slippage bps.
The code correctly acknowledges scanner output does not prove profitability after gas or token transfer behaviour.
Wallet-specific simulation reserves 130% of estimated gas and enforces minimum output before execution.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer false-positive EVM candidates and more realistic ordering by executable net edge after DEX fees, notional-based slippage, price impact, gas, builder costs and latency reserve.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 fresh candidate quotes across multiple gas regimes, 50 wallet-specific simulations and 30 receipt-reconciled executions; report results separately by chain, route type and notional bucket.
proposals.rationale: Applying slippage bps to a small gross edge can materially under-reserve adverse execution cost. The atomic wallet simulation is a strong final guard, but SHADOW ranking and candidate selection can still be distorted.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay EVM candidates with slippage charged against traded notional at each hop and compare predicted net with fresh wallet-specific simulation and, where available, receipt-reconciled net. Fail if median absolute prediction error exceeds 20% of predicted edge, p95 error exceeds the full predicted edge, or net after all costs is non-positive.
proposals.strategy: EVM Cross Venue Net Arbitrage and Learned Route Replication

proposals.downside_risk: Dynamic estimates may be noisy and will likely reduce the number of eligible signals.

evidence.detail: SHADOW entry and exit network/priority fees are fixed estimates of 0.00002 SOL.
Entry validation obtains immediate Jupiter buy and reverse-sell quotes and rejects excessive round-trip loss.
Solana leader events deliberately fail closed with no invented current edge, liquidity or sellability evidence.
The executor captures SOL balance movement and post-execution output evidence, but balance reconciliation is best-effort.

proposals.expected_effect: A chain-specific SHADOW ledger that measures quote-to-fill deterioration, priority/base fees, rent/account effects, failed-attempt fees and exit sellability before judging leader-copy or new-liquidity hypotheses.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 calendar days, 200 eligible signals, 100 complete simulated round trips, coverage of congested and quiet periods, and no unresolved open position older than the strategy horizon.
proposals.rationale: Solana priority fees, account creation/rent, route price impact, quote latency and failed-transaction costs vary materially. Fixed fee assumptions cannot establish durable net profitability, especially for 0.05 SOL notionals.
proposals.shadow_test: Record contemporaneous Jupiter entry and full-size exit quotes, simulation units, recent prioritization-fee estimate, account/rent effects, quote age and eventual executable exit. Calculate money-weighted net SOL. Stop the hypothesis if p95 cost is unbounded, any position lacks a verified exit quote, execution/infrastructure failures exceed 5%, or aggregate net after all costs is non-positive.
proposals.strategy: Solana Leader Copy and New Liquidity Quality

proposals.downside_risk: Potential opportunities may remain untested if data collection is not maintained.

evidence.detail: Directional strategies use fixed heuristic thresholds and weighted scores.
Common net edge subtracts supplied fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve, but its reliability depends entirely on feature completeness.
Runtime forensics are missing, so no realised out-of-sample outcome distribution is available.

proposals.expected_effect: Avoids capital allocation to unsupported directional signals while preserving them as opt-in SHADOW research.
proposals.minimum_observation: Per strategy and chain: at least 90 days, 300 eligible signals, 100 executable outcomes, three volatility/cost regimes and a held-out final third.
proposals.rationale: The hypotheses are reasonable research candidates, but there is no fresh runtime evidence showing calibrated future returns after chain-specific costs. They should not compete for promotion based on heuristic scores or raw win count.
proposals.shadow_test: Use strictly forward, timestamped signals with no look-ahead; mark to an executable exit route at the declared horizon and deduct all chain-specific costs plus failure costs. Reject each family independently if money-weighted net is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, or performance disappears in either the final out-of-sample third or the highest-cost regime.
proposals.strategy: Liquidity Confirmed Momentum, Dislocation Mean Reversion, Flow Acceleration and Forecasted Positive Net Edge

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote EVM atomic arbitrage because wallet simulation enforces positive minimum output.
rejected_ideas.reason: Simulation is a safety gate, not proof of durable realised net profitability or acceptable failure-adjusted returns.

rejected_ideas.idea: Select Solana leaders primarily by win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not the objective and can hide negatively skewed, fee-sensitive outcomes; money-weighted net SOL and drawdown matter.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency to obtain evidence faster.
rejected_ideas.reason: No trade should be forced without positive executable edge, and stale runtime evidence provides no basis for changing participation.

rejected_ideas.idea: Share identical cost thresholds between Solana and EVM.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana priority fees, rent/account effects and Jupiter routing differ from EVM gas, builder payments, approvals and atomic revert economics.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository has useful fail-closed quote, simulation, liquidity and sellability controls, and EVM atomic cycles reconcile receipt gas. However, SHADOW economics and promotion evaluation do not yet demonstrate durable money-weighted net P&L. EVM scanner slippage is reserved from gross profit rather than traded notional, Solana uses fixed fee estimates, and Strategy Lab promotion logic does not gate on execution-failure rate or explicitly separate strategy/market losses from infrastructure failures. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supported.
